package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"math"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

// Optional producer in the pinned public Tempo 2.9.0 checkout. Ordinary Pulse
// tests replay checked-in bytes with Elixir/Rust; Go is not a runtime dependency.
func TestPulseNonfinite(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-trace-nonfinite"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bits := []uint64{0x7ff8000000000000, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000001}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	var rows []*Trace
	for i, b := range bits {
		f := math.Float64frombits(b)
		r := batch(1, "worker", "nonfinite", 1, 0, uint64(100+i), uint64(200+i))
		s := r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
		s.TraceId = make([]byte, 16)
		s.TraceId[15] = 1
		s.SpanId = make([]byte, 8)
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(s.SpanId, uint64(i+1))
		s.Status = &tv.Status{}
		scalar := func() *cv.KeyValue {
			return &cv.KeyValue{Key: "value", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue{DoubleValue: f}}}
		}
		nested := func() *cv.KeyValue {
			return &cv.KeyValue{Key: "nested", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_ArrayValue{ArrayValue: &cv.ArrayValue{Values: []*cv.AnyValue{
				{Value: &cv.AnyValue_KvlistValue{KvlistValue: &cv.KeyValueList{Values: []*cv.KeyValue{scalar()}}}},
			}}}}}
		}
		attrs := func() []*cv.KeyValue { return []*cv.KeyValue{scalar(), nested(), value("literal", fmt.Sprint(f))} }
		r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, attrs()...)
		r.ScopeSpans[0].Scope = &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: "otel", Version: "1", Attributes: attrs()}
		s.Attributes = attrs()
		s.Events = []*tv.Span_Event{{TimeUnixNano: s.StartTimeUnixNano, Name: "event", Attributes: attrs()}}
		s.Links = []*tv.Span_Link{{TraceId: s.TraceId, SpanId: s.SpanId, Attributes: attrs()}}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, r)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, s.TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	type Case struct {
		Target   string `json:"target"`
		Query    string `json:"query"`
		Response any    `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	consumed := 0
	for _, target := range []string{"resource.value", "span.value", "instrumentation.value", "event.value", "link.value", ".value", "span.literal"} {
		for _, query := range []string{"", `{resource.service.name="worker"}`} {
			tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(target)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false })
			if query == "" {
				err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(context.Background(), tag, collect, func(uint64) {}, common.DefaultSearchOptions())
			} else {
				fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
					return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, common.DefaultSearchOptions())
				})
				err = traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, query, collect, fetch)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			vals := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range set {
				v := v
				vals = append(vals, &v)
			}
			sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
				if vals[i].Type == vals[j].Type {
					return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
				}
				return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
			})
			cases = append(cases, Case{target, query, map[string]any{"tagValues": vals}})
			if data, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/result-%02d.protobuf", dir, len(cases)-1)); e == nil {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(data, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(got, &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: vals}) {
					t.Fatalf("consumer mismatch %s %s: %v", target, query, got)
				}
				consumed++
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(e) {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"cases": cases}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, version := range []string{"v1", "v2"} {
		data, e := os.ReadFile(dir + "/export-" + version + ".protobuf")
		if os.IsNotExist(e) {
			continue
		}
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		got := &tempopb.Trace{}
		if version == "v1" {
			e = proto.Unmarshal(data, got)
		} else {
			response := &tempopb.TraceByIDResponse{}
			e = proto.Unmarshal(data, response)
			got = response.Trace
		}
		if e != nil || got == nil || len(got.ResourceSpans) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("export %s: %v", version, e)
		}
		seen := map[uint64]bool{}
		for _, r := range got.ResourceSpans {
			for _, sc := range r.ScopeSpans {
				for _, s := range sc.Spans {
					id := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(s.SpanId)
					if id < 1 || id > uint64(len(bits)) || seen[id] {
						t.Fatal("bad/duplicate span")
					}
					seen[id] = true
					expected := math.Float64frombits(bits[id-1])
					for _, owner := range [][]*cv.KeyValue{r.Resource.Attributes, sc.Scope.Attributes, s.Attributes, s.Events[0].Attributes, s.Links[0].Attributes} {
						found := 0
						var check func([]*cv.KeyValue)
						check = func(attrs []*cv.KeyValue) {
							for _, a := range attrs {
								switch a.Key {
								case "value":
									v, ok := a.Value.Value.(*cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue)
									if !ok {
										t.Fatal("lost double type")
									}
									if math.IsNaN(expected) {
										if !math.IsNaN(v.DoubleValue) {
											t.Fatal("lost NaN")
										}
									} else if math.Float64bits(expected) != math.Float64bits(v.DoubleValue) {
										t.Fatal("lost double value/sign")
									}
									found++
								case "nested":
									check(a.Value.GetArrayValue().Values[0].GetKvlistValue().Values)
								}
							}
						}
						check(owner)
						if found != 2 {
							t.Fatal("missing nested/scalar value")
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if len(seen) != len(bits) {
			t.Fatal("missing spans")
		}
		consumed++
	}
	if os.Getenv("PULSE_REQUIRE_CONSUMER") == "1" && consumed != len(cases)+2 {
		t.Fatalf("consumed %d, want %d", consumed, len(cases)+2)
	}
	t.Logf("public Tempo cases=%d consumed=%d; export compares NaN class, not NaN payload bits", len(cases), consumed)
}
